lines.text: مستعلی بود کمی باران ونم بود واگر قمر مستعلی بود بسیاری باران ونم بود در وقت (مقارنه
lines.en: it is ascendant, there will be little rain and moisture, and if the Moon is ascendant, there will be much rain and moisture at the time of (the conjunction of

lines.en: the Moon and Mars in the watery triplicity), it indicates the death of commanders and their movement, and difficulty for ships,

lines.text: وبدی حال مسافران وفناء مرغ ونقصان جانوران ورعد وبرق وتاریکی هوا در وقت
lines.en: and bad condition for travelers, and the perishing of birds, and the decrease of animals, and thunder and lightning, and darkness of the air at the time.

lines.text: (اگر در سرطان بود) دلالت کند بر غوغای عوام وفساد بدکاران وزحمت مسافران
lines.en: (If it is in Cancer), it indicates the clamor of the common people, and the corruption of evildoers, and the trouble of travelers

lines.text: دریا وارتفاع بخارات ودشواری وضع حمل وفناء دابها وتیرکی هوا ودلمشغولی
lines.en: by sea, and the rising of vapors, and difficulty in childbirth, and the perishing of beasts of burden, and darkness of the air, and the preoccupation of

lines.text: عوام الناس وهراس در مردم وغوغا وگفتگوی زنان وفناء حال بدکاران وزجر
lines.en: the common people, and fear among the people, and clamor and talk of women, and the perishing of the condition of evildoers, and the scolding of

lines.text: ایشان ونم وباران ورعد وبرق در وقت وفتنه ومرك یکی از فرماندهان ونفقه
lines.en: them, and moisture and rain, and thunder and lightning at the time, and sedition and the death of one of the commanders, and the expenditure of

lines.text: ملوك مال بسیار در ابواب لشکریان واهل حرب وقصد سلاطین بیکدیگر وغرق سفاین
lines.en: kings of much wealth on the affairs of soldiers and people of war, and the intention of sultans against one another, and the sinking of ships

lines.text: در وقت مبادی کلیه وجزئیه وفصول وتحاویل واجتماعات واستقبالات اکثر الوقوع
lines.en: at the time of universal and particular beginnings, and seasons, and revolutions, and conjunctions, and oppositions, most frequently occurring.

lines.text: باشد اگر مریخ مستعلی بود باران ونم بسیار باشد واگر قمر مستعلی بود بسیاری شورش بود
lines.en: If Mars is ascendant, there will be much rain and moisture, and if the Moon is ascendant, there will be much rebellion

lines.text: در اکثر بلاد وموت مردم بود بیشتر در فارس وروم وخشکی هوا (واگر در عقرب بود)
lines.en: in most cities, and the death of people will be mostly in Fars and Rome, and the dryness of the air. (And if it is in Scorpio),

lines.text: خوف مسافران بود خاصه مسافران دریا ورنجد جاسوسان وعفونت ابها وپیدا
lines.en: there will be fear for travelers, especially travelers by sea, and spies will suffer, and the putrefaction of waters, and the appearance

lines.text: شدن بخارها وکدورت هوا واندوه زنان وبیماری ایشان وخصومت ازواج و
lines.en: of vapors, and the turbidity of the air, and the sorrow of women, and their illness, and the enmity of spouses, and

lines.text: محبوس عوام وناله ایشان از بدکاران وستم ومرك یکی از اعیان وغارت ورعد وبرق
lines.en: the imprisonment of the common people and their groaning from evildoers and oppression, and the death of one of the notables, and plunder, and thunder and lightning,

lines.text: وباران در وقت واگر مریخ مستعلی بود مرك بزرگی باشد در عراق عرب وخوزستان
lines.en: and rain at the time. And if Mars is elevated, there will be the death of a great one in Arab Iraq and Khuzestan,

lines.text: وبسیاری فتنه در فارس وروم ورعد وبرق واگر قمر مستعلی بود بسیاری ابها بود ورعد
lines.en: and much sedition in Fars and Rome, and thunder and lightning. And if the Moon is elevated, there will be much water, and thunder

lines.text: ورعد وصاعقه (واگر در حوت بود) دلالت بر رنج مسافران وافت کشتیها و زیان
lines.en: and thunder and lightning. (And if it is in Pisces), it indicates the suffering of travelers, and the calamity of ships, and the loss

lines.text: زنان ومکروه عوام وبسیاری بخارات تیره وتکدر هوا وکدورت علما واشراف
lines.en: women, and the detestation of the common people, and many dark vapors, and turbidity of the air, and turbidity of scholars and nobles,

lines.text: ومرك حیوانات ابی وبدحالی صیادان دریا وحسرت تجار وهلاك بزرگی وفتنه وغارت
lines.en: and the death of aquatic animals, and the bad condition of sea fishermen, and the regret of merchants, and the perishing of a great one, and sedition and plunder,

lines.text: وبیماری دزدان در ولایت روم وکوهستان وبارندگی در وقت اگر مریخ مستعلی
lines.en: and the illness of thieves in the province of Rome and the mountains, and rainfall at the time. If Mars is ascendant,

lines.text: بود هلاك مردم بابل وفارس بود واگر قمر مستعلی بود باد وباران بسیار باشد
lines.en: there will be the perishing of the people of Babylon and Fars, and if the Moon is ascendant, there will be much wind and rain.

sections.en: Conjunction of the Moon and Mars

summary.headline: Moon–Mars Conjunctions and Inferior Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of the Moon and Mars in the watery triplicity and in Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, including rain, rebellion, disease, shipwrecks, deaths, and disturbances in Fars, Rome, Arab Iraq, Khuzestan, Babylon, and the mountains. Chapter Four then begins discussion of inferior conjunctions in the four triplicities and twelve signs, opening with Mercury and Venus.
